name: Kontroversiya
source:
"It all starts with a simple dispute. A stupid bet that seemingly couldn't be more than just a friendly competition. And victory seems as easy as it gets for the protagonist, considering he lacks empathy. However, the further he goes in his attempts to take first place, the harder it becomes for him to ignore the feelings of others."

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2941960129]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“这一切都是从一场简单的争执开始的。一场愚蠢的赌注，看似只是一场友好的比赛。而对于缺乏同理心的主角来说，胜利似乎是轻而易举的事情。然而，他越是试图获得第一，他就越难忽视别人的感受。”

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2941960129]Steam[/url]]
